run_kprobe_do_unlinkat: run a kprobe on the do_unlinkat kernel function to trace file unlink operations
create_bpf_queue: create a BpfQueue datastructure to collect events from a kprobe into a ctypes Structure
probe_read_kernel_memory: use probe_read to safely read a kernel pointer value into a user-space buffer
get_current_comm: use get_current_comm to capture the current process command name into a ctypes field
perf_event_output: use perf_event_output to send a kprobe event to a BpfQueue on a specific CPU
